research_question: Does the already-frozen KNOW39 probabilistic readout plus deferred writes generalize to previously unseen structural causal graphs and improve counterfactual intervention choice beyond fully fitted HMM and symbolic Bayesian hypotheses, under identical action/observation information?
novelty_boundary: This is an entirely new frozen causal-structure challenge, not KNOW36–39's recurring truth tables or seeded replay; known model implementation is unchanged and Git blob pinned. Not native learning, not CausalGym, not active policy rollout. Score shadow intervention proposals before common forced action; outcomes remain causally affected by forced a.

scm.context: c=t%8; 3 observed binary context bits c0,c1,c2
scm.action: a=floor(t/8)%2 fixed forced by evaluator; both interventions are well-defined
scm.physical_input: x=c XOR (a<<1), resulting physical bits x0,x1,x2
scm.outcome: y∼Bernoulli(0.85 if f_graph(x)==1 else 0.15), with evaluator-only SHA256 coin
scm.intervention_effect: do(a) changes only x1, all other bits fixed; counterfactual q(c,0),q(c,1) are evaluated but counterfactual y is never opened
scm.fit_worlds: A=F1,B=F2 for F12, reversed for F21
scm.structural_disjointness: H1/H2 both nonlinear context-dependent interactions; FIT F1/F2 linear; no held graph formula is a fit template. 4 of 8 contexts have nonzero action effects in each held law.
scm.information: learners receive only public (t,x,y). Never graph label, phase, seed, true q, future or counterfactual sampled y.

source.source_first_use: Fresh deterministic synthetic source only; prospective first attempt after exact Git source/experiment protocol, both OS focused, atlas seal, final full regression both OS and read-only historical compatibility; never execute source generator or proof during tests; no uncertain retry.

methods.candidate: Exact unchanged KNOW39 SoftDeferred('soft', selected_hazard) source Git blob 4b61ecf922626e55a80e8390e5a28a34a8ed474e; state and code frozen before KNOW40
methods.hmm: Exact unchanged KNOW36 Comparator('hmm', hazard) two-head global HMM; hazard FIT-only chosen from [1/128,1/32,1/8] by pooled expected Brier on FIT t64..255
methods.symbolic: Conventional 256-state exhaustive Bayesian truth-table filter, all 2^8 possible Bernoulli structural laws, uniform prior, state transition mixture (1-h)posterior + h/256, likelihood .85/.15 from witnessed public x,y; separately FIT-optimize h on same three candidate hazards; strong but larger memory/compute than candidate.
methods.lookup: Conventional 8 Beta(1,1) per physical x, online every y; no state switching
methods.buffer: Exact unmodified KNOW38 buffered prewrite candidate, unchanged source
methods.random: Law-blind SHA256('know40:random-action:v1:'+t+':'+c) mod 2, evaluated as action-choice negative control; never changes common observed action sequence
methods.fairness: All actual learners observe identical forced t,x,y (FIT/HELD) and each forecasts both potential actions pre-observation. No model may choose the observations it receives. Symbolic uses more state and compute; report costs, do not claim equal capacity or active-intervention learning.

scoring.prequential: For observed forced x score q(1-q)+(p-q)^2 before witnessing y; true q scorer-only
scoring.shadow_policy: At each t, evaluate model p(c,do0),p(c,do1) and choose argmax (ties choose action0); regret=max[q(c,do0),q(c,do1)]-q(c,chosen). No counterfactual outcome is sampled or fed back, common actual forced action remains fixed.
scoring.metrics: Family means and paired-world wins for B_first, A_return, B_second expected Brier and expected shadow-policy regret; check input-action 16 support per 16 events, nontrivial oracle opportunity (>=4/8 context action contrasts), cold state, posterior bank custody, false B memory admissions, byte/cost differences.

hypotheses.P0: 12 FIT +24 disjoint novel HELD, exact 3072 FIT and 9216 HELD novel source calls, exact 10752 model observations per arm, 16 forced (c,a) support per 16 events, 4/8 held action contrasts, no policy selection affects observed data, all arms cold-restorable
hypotheses.P1: candidate A-prefix Brier <=0.23 in both held graph families
hypotheses.H1: Second-B candidate mean shadow action regret at least 0.035 lower than BOTH fitted HMM and fitted symbolic in BOTH held families; >=9/12 paired-world regret wins over the better strong baseline in EACH family
hypotheses.H2: Second-B candidate expected Brier <= min(fitted HMM,symbolic)-0.005 in BOTH families and >=9/12 paired-world Brier wins versus better baseline separately
hypotheses.H3: Return-A candidate regret <= best strong baseline+0.02 AND candidate Brier <= fitted HMM+0.005 in BOTH families
hypotheses.H4: Original A bank frozen t64 stays byte-identical through t192, B bank at t128 stays byte-identical through t192, all 24, exact checksum cold state/readout at t64/128/192/256
hypotheses.H5: A-only sham false B admissions <=2/24 and max candidate checkpoint <4096 bytes
hypotheses.H6: Second-B candidate mean regret at least .035 lower than BOTH lookup and unchanged KNOW38 in BOTH held families
hypotheses.decision: DEVELOPMENT_SUPPORTED iff every P0,P1,H1,H2,H3,H4,H5,H6 passes. Else DEVELOPMENT_MIXED_OR_NO_GO. Regardless synthetic result: scientific_gain_verified=false, native SCiENTIFIC_PASS=false, DEPLOYMENT=NONE.
hypotheses.budget: One synthetic held first use only, max 12 fit and 24 held worlds, no post-result retune or replay, stop and record every fail/negative. Original-world #426 first use not authorized.
